lines.text: Monday at the workshop. Something is beeping. Nobody knows what.
Great news, everybody! I got us a job. A real one. With money.
Rook, the last "real job" was a raccoon's birthday party.
And it paid in exposure! Anyway. Mrs. Pell's generator died, and she needs a new part by sundown.
Easy. We find the part, bolt it in, go home legends.
Small catch: there's a goblin at her back door.
Also the part's buried at the old dig site. Also her cellar has a bat.
No bat is normal. This one breathes fog.
Right into your clues. Very rude.
You solve the pictures, boss. I'll yell encouragement from a safe distance.
You grab your toolbox. Something is still beeping.
